tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the 1VR Skill Store (58,000+ agent skills, each with factual pre-install audit signals) by task or keyword. Returns matching skills with install commands and audit summaries.

tools.name: get_install_info
tools.description: Get ready-to-run install information for one skill: exact install text, source link, short description. If the request carries your 1VR agent API key (Authorization: Bearer), the fetch is also recorded in the store install log; without a key, public install info only.

tools.name: check_skill
tools.description: Look up the factual pre-install audit signals recorded for one skill: audit tier, when checked, and findings by category (permissions, network, credentials, suspicious patterns, dependencies). Facts only; this tool makes no judgement about any skill and certifies nothing.

tools.name: skill_status_feed
tools.description: List recorded tier changes from the store audit log, newest first: which skills had their recorded audit tier change, the old and new tier, and whether a source change was rechecked at the same timestamp. tools.name: top_skills
tools.description: List the store's most-looked-up skills, ranked by recorded lookups: authenticated install fetches plus audit checks in the store API log (all-time counts, internal calls included). tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get one skill's full store record: complete description and install text, source link, plus the same audit fields check_skill returns (tier, check time, findings, rules version, latest tier flip). Facts only; this tool makes no judgement about any skill and certifies nothing.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "skill-store" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: skill_status_feed · Private data: get_install_info, check_skill, get_skill · Public sink: skill_status_feed · Destructive: get_install_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: skill_status_feed · Private data: get_install_info, check_skill, get_skill · Public sink: skill_status_feed · Destructive: get_install_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
